bullets.text: Apple TV's New Drama Series - **Apple TV** launches 'Down Cemetery Road' to keep viewers engaged post 'Slow Horses'.
iOS 26's Controversial Feature Returns - **Apple** reintroduces notification summaries for News and Entertainment apps in iOS 26.
Spotify's Revamped Apple TV App - **Spotify** launches a new Apple TV app with enhanced features for a better user experience.
Uplift Network Launches - **World Mobile** and Tristan Thompson unveil a community-owned mobile network offering affordable data plans.
AI Audio Models to Be Commoditized - **ElevenLabs** CEO predicts that AI audio models will become commoditized over time.
Microsoft Azure Outage Impact - **Microsoft** Azure experiences a significant outage affecting multiple services including **Xbox**.
Fubo and Hulu Live TV Merge - **Fubo** officially combines with **Hulu Live TV**, creating a major player in the streaming market.
AI in Wildfire Detection - **Hewlett Packard Enterprise** partners with Vail to enhance wildfire detection using AI technology.
Bending Spoons to Acquire AOL - **Bending Spoons** announces plans to acquire **AOL**, aiming to revitalize the iconic brand.
